project_new.description: Create an empty HachiShifter project / 新建工程

project_open.description: Open HJPX, legacy HSPX, MPD, MIDI, or audio from path / 打开工程或素材

project_save.description: Save current project as HJPX / 保存工程

project_snapshot.description: Read every current track, clip, note, pitch and marker / 读取全部工程内容

import_audio.description: Import an audio file at start_seconds / 导入音频

analyse_audio.description: Run configured GAME+FCPE analysis with native fallback and return actual backend / 执行 GAME+FCPE 分析并报告实际后端

analysis_status.description: Inspect GAME large/small, FCPE and inference availability / 查看 GAME、FCPE 与推理状态

import_midi.description: Import MIDI notes and tempo / 导入 MIDI

export_midi.description: Write all tracks or one track as MIDI, retaining conductor tempo/meter and lyrics / 导出 MIDI

export_ust.description: Export one monophonic track as UST, retaining imported opaque data / 导出单轨 UST

import_ust.description: Import a UTAU project as a plain UTAU track / 导入 UST

import_melodyne.description: Import Melodyne MPD edits; recursive_media, preserve_edits and source_pitch control import / 导入 Melodyne 工程并控制素材搜索、工程编辑与原始 F0

restore_merged_consonant.description: Restore archived original consonant/vowel fragments through the common Model authority

set_tempo.description: Set BPM and time signature / 设置速度与拍号

add_track.description: Create a melodic, audio or accompaniment track / 新建旋律、普通或伴奏轨道

set_track.description: Set compose, mute, solo, gain, pan and render algorithms / 设置轨道及算法

set_clip.description: Set clip gain, fades and mute state / 设置采样增益、淡入淡出和静音

move_clip.description: Move a clip on the timeline / 移动采样

resize_clip.description: Stretch a whole clip while preserving its source media / 整体拉伸采样并保留原始素材

duplicate_clip.description: Deep-copy a clip and its notes to a timeline position / 深度复制采样及其音符到指定位置

transpose_note.description: Move a note and its whole contour / 整体移动音高线

edit_notes_pitch.description: Batch transpose, set, average or quantize note pitches / 批量移调、设置、平均或量化音符

duplicate_notes.description: Deep-copy selected notes into a target clip / 深度复制所选音符到目标采样

resize_note.description: Change note time bounds / 修改音符时间

set_note.description: Set pitch, Robust Pitch Curve, tension, breath, formant, gain, Attack and consonant parameters / 设置稳健音高线及全部音符参数

set_pitch_curve.description: Draw an absolute target-pitch curve without replacing source F0 / 绘制目标音高线并保留原始 F0

add_note.description: Create a note in a clip / 在采样中创建音符

remove_note.description: Delete a note / 删除音符

toggle_note_connection.description: Connect or separate adjacent notes / 连接或分离相邻音符

set_notes_portamento.description: Set real pitch-only glide bridges; never join source audio or change envelopes / 设置真实滑音连接，不拼接素材

remove_clip.description: Delete a clip / 删除采样

remove_track.description: Delete a track / 删除轨道

undo.description: Undo the last project edit / 撤销工程编辑

redo.description: Redo the last project edit / 重做工程编辑

utau_render_selection.description: Choose which UTAU notes render and play; empty selects every note / 选择参与 UTAU 渲染与试听的音符

set_utau_resampler.description: Point UTAU rendering at a resampler executable / 指定 UTAU 重采样器

render_prepare.description: Pre-render the current project with its selected algorithms / 按当前所选算法预渲染工程

render_status.description: Read pre-render progress and active backends / 读取预渲染进度与实际后端

export_wav.description: Render every note and export to WAV; track_id exports one track alone, from_seconds/to_seconds one stretch / 渲染全曲并导出 WAV，track_id 可单独导出一个轨道

transport_play.description: Render if needed and start playback; play_until_seconds stops where a selection ends / 必要时预渲染并开始播放

transport_stop.description: Stop transport playback / 停止播放

transport_seek.description: Seek transport to position_seconds / 跳转播放位置

transport_status.description: Read playback position and render state / 读取播放位置与渲染状态

sample_settings_read.description: Read or derive audio otto.ini regions / 读取或生成音频 otto.ini 分段

sample_settings_save.description: Save audio regions to otto.ini / 保存音频分段到 otto.ini

oto_import.description: Import one audio file's regions from UTAU oto.ini / 从 UTAU oto.ini 导入单个音频分段

oto_export.description: Export one audio file's regions to UTAU oto.ini / 将单个音频分段导出为 UTAU oto.ini

jie_oto_create.description: Seed a voicebank's four-region oto4.ini from its oto.ini / 按 oto.ini 生成界•OTO

voicebank_import.description: Inspect a UTAU or native material folder without writing annotations / 只读检查 UTAU 或原生素材目录，不写入标注

read_file.description: Read a byte range as base64 / 读取任意文件内容

list_directory.description: List a directory with type and size / 列出目录内容

editor_selection.description: Read ONLY notes currently selected in the editor / 读取当前选区。Use FIRST for 'these notes', 'this phrase', or 'what did I select'. Returns lyrics, note names, timing and tracks; empty selection returns no notes, NEVER the whole project.

editor_status.description: Read the connected window, current file, revision, selection, playback and DS state

editor_query.description: Read selected notes by default; range uses absolute project seconds; curves are opt-in

editor_select.description: Change real GUI selection and focus; [] clears it

editor_batch.description: Apply up to 128 project edit commands atomically with one Undo; imports, file and transport commands are excluded

editor_job_status.description: Read a background job's state/result; completed does not imply success, check result.isError

editor_cancel_job.description: Cancel a pending job; staged edits are discarded, external file writes may already have completed

ds_generate_pitch.description: Regenerate DS pitch using GUI logic; selection required unless whole_track=true

ds_generate_parameters.description: Regenerate DS prediction parameters using GUI logic; preserve offsets and unselected notes

ds_query_phonemes.description: Predict phoneme timing in full phrase context, returning only selected notes by default; includes stable note IDs and timing context

ds_capabilities.description: Inspect the focused DS voicebank and its parameter support asynchronously

ds_set_pitch_offset.description: Set an independent additive semitone curve; preserves the original prediction reference

ds_set_parameter.description: Set a DS actual parameter or offset curve; supports only parameters exposed by this voicebank

ds_set_pronunciation.description: Set per-note pronunciation override; empty text restores automatic conversion

ds_set_timing.description: Set phoneme onset overrides from an inspected timing context; null restores prediction

hamood_analyse_audio.description: Analyse one accompaniment clip with Beat This! small0 + BTC; background job, cached by source audio/model hash. Read-only project operation. No pitch or tempo edits.

hamood_alignment_preview.description: Preview a small beat-phase offset against the existing project tempo grid. Does NOT resolve whole-bar ambiguity or change audio/tempo. Inspect start/middle/end windows before applying move_clip.

hamood_audio_context.description: Read cached timestamped chords, low-register chroma candidates, beats and downbeats on the CURRENT project timeline. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Defaults to selected-note time range; explicit range or whole_clip required otherwise.

hamood_get_context.description: Read project-persisted HAMOOD settings, manual key ranges, chord timeline, section labels and confirmation states. Timeline positions use quarter notes.

hamood_set_context.description: Replace HAMOOD project metadata with one undo step; read hamood_get_context first and preserve unrelated entries. schema=1; settings object; chords, sections, key_predictions arrays. Chords require start_quarter/end_quarter, label, pitch_classes 0..11, score 0..1 and confirmed. Confirmed chords survive audio reanalysis.

hamood_generate.description: 生成独立和声轨道，一次撤销
